source_refs.note: Exercise 14.2, Question 5: vector with zero dot product with i, j, k (book p.275). Answer agrees with the key (PDF 312).

blocks.prompt: 5. If \(\underline{v}\) is a vector for which \(\underline{v}\cdot\underline{i} = 0\), \(\underline{v}\cdot\underline{j} = 0\), \(\underline{v}\cdot\underline{k} = 0\), find \(\underline{v}\).
blocks.explanation:
Kisi vector ka \(\underline{i}\) se dot product us vector ka \(\underline{i}\) wala component deta hai; isi tarah \(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\).
Diya kya hai? Teen dot products, teeno zero.
Find kya karna hai? \(\underline{v}\).
Plan: \(\underline{v} = a\underline{i} + b\underline{j} + c\underline{k}\) maan kar teen dot products likhein; teeno components seedha mil jayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{v}\cdot\underline{i} = 0\), \(\underline{v}\cdot\underline{j} = 0\), \(\underline{v}\cdot\underline{k} = 0\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{v}\).
Tareeqa: Maan lein \(\underline{v} = a\underline{i} + b\underline{j} + c\underline{k}\). Phir 14.2.2 ke results istemal karenge: \(\underline{i}\cdot\underline{i} = 1\) aur \(\underline{i}\cdot\underline{j} = \underline{i}\cdot\underline{k} = 0\), waghera. Jab vector maloom na ho to usay components mein maan lena hi pehla qadam hota hai.

\(\underline{i}\) se dot product
\[\underline{v}\cdot\underline{i} = a(1) + b(0) + c(0) = a\]
\[a = 0\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\) ko components mein likhein to \(1\underline{i} + 0\underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\) hai. Matching components multiply karne par sirf \(a \times 1\) bachta hai, baqi dono zero. Is liye \(\underline{v}\cdot\underline{i}\) asal mein \(\underline{v}\) ka \(\underline{i}\) wala component hai, aur woh zero diya hai.

\(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) se dot product
\[\underline{v}\cdot\underline{j} = b = 0\]
\[\underline{v}\cdot\underline{k} = c = 0\]
Kyun: Bilkul wohi baat: \(\underline{j}\) sirf \(b\) ko aur \(\underline{k}\) sirf \(c\) ko 'pakarta' hai. Dono zero diye hain.

\(\underline{v}\) likhein
\[\underline{v} = 0\underline{i} + 0\underline{j} + 0\underline{k} = \underline{0}\]
Kyun: Teeno components zero hain, is liye \(\underline{v}\) zero vector hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\underline{0}\cdot\underline{i} = \underline{0}\cdot\underline{j} = \underline{0}\cdot\underline{k} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Zero vector ka har vector se dot product zero hota hai; kitab ke 14.2.6 ke Note ke mutabiq zero vector har vector par perpendicular mana jata hai. Soch kar dekhiye: koi non-zero vector teeno axes par ek saath perpendicular nahi ho sakta, kyunke kisi na kisi axis ki taraf us ka kuch hissa zaroor hoga.
Dhyan dein: Jawab mein sirf '0' (number) mat likhiye; \(\underline{v}\) vector hai, is liye jawab zero vector \(\underline{0}\) hai.
